LESSON: READING 3.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Reading 3.2.1 Intensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 3.2.1 Intensive Reading, part of Strand 3 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can one improve the way they read? 2. Which skills should one use in order to read effectively?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. predict events by focusing on the title and illustrations in a text,

2. individually, silently read a passage on pollution so as to internalize the information,

3. read the passage aloud in turns as they answer oral questions that are asked,

4. infer the meaning of given words using synonyms, contexts among others,

5. work with peers to recapture events in the text as they role play,

6. write answers to the questions given after the passage correctly. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. predict events by focusing on the title and illustrations in a text,
2. individually, silently read a passage on pollution so as to internalize the information,
3. read the passage aloud in turns as they answer oral questions that are asked,
4. infer the meaning of given words using synonyms, contexts among others,
5. work with peers to recapture events in the text as they role play,
6. write answers to the questions given after the passage correctly. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 3.2.1 Intensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking: It is cultivated as the learner infers meanings of words used in the passage.

• Communication and collaboration: It is promoted as the learner works with peers to infer meanings of given words.

Values:
Patriotism: It is fostered as the learner acquires knowledge on pollution and how to improve the environment by reading varied

texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental education awareness: It is enhanced as the learner reads a passage on pollution.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates intensive reading to other learning areas where intensive reading is a critical skill such as in Social Studies

and Kiswahili.
